search_parameters: Following modifications of peptides were allowed: carbamidomethylation (cysteine), oxidation (methionine), deamidation (asparagine and glutamine), acetylation (protein N terminus), methionine loss (protein N terminus), NBF (163.0012, lysine and cysteine), DCP-Bio1 (394.1557, cysteine) and hydrolyzed DCP-Bio1 (168.0786, cysteine).

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment targets S-persulfidation using a dimedone-based chemical switch to convert unstable persulfides into stable biotinylated (DCP-Bio1) or fluorescent (NBF) tags for affinity enrichment and MS detection. While the final analysis reported 'protein abundance', the enrichment is site-specific to cysteines.
